summary_md: **Neko\_Yukari ([@Neko__Yukari](https://x.com/Neko__Yukari/status/2116770312155263069))** released a **Tripo Studio MCP** that uses a logged-in Tripo Studio account's credits and exposes an API matching the official Tripo API for text- or image-to-3D workflows, with a few features like stylization not yet supported ([Neko-Yukari/tripo-studio-mcp](https://github.com/Neko-Yukari/tripo-studio-mcp)).
